segments.name: Scours
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells the First Defense product line of scours preventatives for neonatal dairy and beef calves.
segments.evidence: Scours segment - consists of the First Defense ® product line.

segments.name: Mastitis
segments.description: Sells the California Mastitis Test product line and develops Re-Tain, a treatment for subclinical mastitis in lactating cows.
segments.evidence: Mastitis segment - includes our CMT product line, consisting of reagents and equipment used for rapid cow-side testing to identify mastitic quarters by detecting elevated somatic cell counts.

revenueModel.text: The company sells its products primarily through major animal health distributors who resell to veterinary clinics, fleet stores and farms.
revenueModel.evidence: The First Defense ® product line and CMT are sold primarily through major animal health distributors who, in turn, sell to veterinary clinics, fleet stores and direct to farms.

changes.text: In 2025, the company ceased its focus on obtaining FDA approval of Re-Tain and paused further investment in its manufacturing.
changes.evidence: On December 23, 2025, we made the decision to cease our focus on obtaining FDA approval of Re-Tain ® and instead continue the stability and investigational testing related to Re-Tain ® .
